scope: one context, one subject, one unary extensional atom; no rules, imports, automatic P0 or P2-e migration, clinical writes or base conversion
time: strict UTC second timestamps; as_of controls record, refinement and human confirmation visibility; target_at selects the explicitly asserted or refined half-open bounded validity; no inferred persistence or prediction

validity.bounded: required start < end; start <= target_at < end
validity.unknown: an eligible record blocks with validity_unknown until exactly one distinct eligible refinement interval exists
validity.unspecified: an eligible record blocks with validity_unspecified until exactly one distinct eligible refinement interval exists
validity.open_end: recognized but unsupported_profile; never filled as forever

refinement: a refinement assigns a bounded validity to an earlier record whose validity is unknown or unspecified; eligible when certainty is confirmed and at least one visible human confirmed review binds the target and the refinement by content hash; identical eligible intervals collapse, distinct ones are a conflict (never latest-wins); the original record is retained and never rewritten; refinements of refinements, retractions and conflict resolution are unsupported
revision: revises targets same atom/context and strictly earlier records; the reviser must be bounded; bounded targets require the static containing interval; unknown or unspecified targets are checked per view against the single eligible refined interval, and a reviser outside it stops the row with revision_outside_refined_validity; all applicable eligible revision edges mask their targets even when the reviser is masked
eligibility: confirmed certainty AND at least one visible human confirmed review; review recorded_at >= recorded_at of what it confirms
stops: unknown capability on ANY visible record or refinement takes precedence; then unresolved or conflicting validity of eligible records; then revision containment against refined validity; structural validation is independent of budget
answers: unassessed rows have null literal state, adoption sets and evidence; finished rows retain visible human review, refinement and revision-edge evidence; never certify or add clinical assertions
steps: 1 request start + sum_view(N_assertions + N_reviews + N_refinements + N_refinement_reviews + sum_query(2 + N_visible + N_visible_refinements + N_eligible_revision_edges)); prepay scans, then commit each row; shared budget; sorted IDs; no cache discounts
limitations: no refinement of refinements, retraction, conflict resolution, instant or aggregate to period inheritance, longitudinal comparison, persistent identity store or clinical validity guarantee
